name: sharp
vision: Strong poses held still and changed quickly: reads at a distance and on a small low-polygon body.

idle: For a small or stylised body seen from far: the shift takes 26 frames and the head looks, holds and looks back.
Not tried: a shift under 20 frames. The held poses are still but for breath and fingers (3 degrees), which is the point of it.
crouch_idle: Tight and alert: the right foot only 0.40 m behind, turned out 18 degrees, its heel up 38 and its knee 0.36 m up; the hips turned 7 degrees; the right arm bent 62 degrees with its hand held outside the knee, the left forearm on the thigh with the fingers closed further; the head looks, holds and looks back.
Could not be done: both hands held forward of the knees: they met, 26 mm inside each other on the female; the right hand is carried 16 degrees out.
crouch_walk: Sharp: 180 steps a minute, the pelvis dipping 8 mm, the arms swinging 7 and 13 degrees.

Tried: the idle's hand numbers in the walk: the left hand's turn popped 1.4 degrees on a landing frame as the arm was opened round the thigh; the walk has its own wrists and carries the arms 25 and 18 degrees out, as fits the shipped crouch idle B.
stand_to_crouch: Sharp: 15 frames, falling for 66 % of the drop; 0.91 of gravity.
Could not be done: 13 frames. With a foot in the air the trunk's fold and the step add to the fall: 1.20 of gravity (the limit is 1.05).
crouch_to_stand: Sharp: 15 frames, the legs pushing for the first third; the rise stops at 1.04 of gravity (the limit is 1.05).
Could not be done: 14 frames: the rise stopped at 1.24 of gravity.
walk: Sharp: a quiet trunk (the hips turn 6 degrees and tip 5, 34 mm of rise), a higher step, elbows bent 26 degrees, each side its own numbers at four fifths of the grounded one's and its own timing, parts trail under a frame.
Not tried: held keys with fewer in-betweens; every change is still eased, so it is quieter, not snappier, than the grounded one. Its keys are 23.7 KB a second in the file, the most of the three.
jog: Sharp: the knee lifts higher (the foot passes 13 cm over its straight path), the front hand comes higher than the back one goes, the hips turn 9 degrees and tip 5, the right arm tighter, later and its shoulder lower.
Not tried: a shorter contact than the grounded one's six frames (five is 25 % of the cycle, under what people run with at this speed).
sprint: Sharp: more lean (the trunk 12 degrees forward), a higher knee, the elbows held at a right angle, the hips turn 14 degrees and tip 5, the right arm tighter, later and its shoulder lower.
Not tried: 16 frames a cycle (225 steps a minute, over the range): a contact would be under four frames.
jump_start: Sharp: a push of 5 frames, the legs straight by frame 1.8 with the toes at 53 and 48 degrees.

The game gives a take-off no frame on the floor (the capsule leaves on the tick of the press at 6.25 m/s), so no variant crouches first: at 0.2 m a frame the feet would be 0.2 to 0.4 m under the capsule.
jump_start_run_l: Sharp: a push of 5 frames, 4 cm of drive and trail, the arm pumped 3 degrees.
The shortest way from the stride to the rise: a joint's speed changes up to 26 degrees in a frame.
jump_start_run_r: Sharp: a push of 5 frames, 2 cm of drive and trail.
A joint's speed changes up to 48 degrees in a frame; the limit it declares is 85.
jump_rise: Sharp: one strong line, the left arm 56 degrees forward, the right fist at the hip, the left leg straight and pointed, the right knee high (thigh 44, knee 82).
Before kit #1369 the left arm was 124 degrees up; an arm that high cannot float there and back inside the rise.
jump_apex: Sharp: a tight tuck, the thighs 40 and 72 degrees forward and the knees at 88 and 112.
The feet come 6 cm higher under the body than the grounded one's.
jump_fall: Sharp: the feet closer (0.11 m apart fore and aft), the elbows bent 46 and 58.
Its heels are up 18 and 22 degrees: nearly level with each other, the least staggered of the three.
land_soft: Sharp: down 0.16 m in 2 frames, up in 10, 19 frames; the right foot lands a frame after the left, 0.11 m ahead, and is back by frame 14.
A joint's speed changes 29 degrees in a frame, the hardest of the three soft landings.
land_hard: Sharp: down in 4 frames, held 2, up in 13, 33 frames; control at frame 17.
Tried: the trunk reaching its fold a frame after the weight: the spine turned 0.6 degrees by itself as the right foot landed; it reaches it 3 frames after.
land_to_jog: Sharp: no sink beyond the curve between the fall and the jog's take-off, the chest folds 3 degrees.
It keeps 2.4 m/s of the fall on its first frame, the least of the three.
idle_to_walk: Quick off the mark: 30 and 27 frames (left, right) over 1.03 m, 4 to 7 frames of gathering, a 10 frame first step, the lean barely late.
It pushes harder than a body can: lean 10.7 degrees off (declared 12).
idle_to_jog: Three landings, not four: 31 and 29 frames (left, right) over 2.18 m; one slow step, then the jog's own two contacts. It ends on the foot it began with, so the clip on the left foot joins the jog at frame 0.

It pushes harder than a body can: lean 21.5 degrees off (declared 23). Tried: the hips as low as the grounded one's: an ankle folded 56 to 58 degrees (the limit is 55); they come down by 8 % of the lean and the heels rise earlier.
idle_to_sprint: Five landings, not six: 47 and 45 frames (left, right) over 5.17 m.
Lean 25.5 degrees off (declared 28). Tried: feet reaching 0.40 m behind: the pelvis was lowered 0.19 m and an ankle folded 57 degrees; they reach 0.34.
walk_stop: 28 frames over 0.38 m: the root is at rest three frames after the second foot lands and the settle is 7 frames.
jog_stop: Three landings after the strike, not four: 37 frames over 1.37 m; one brake step, then the two standing places.
It brakes harder than a body can: lean 23.7 degrees off (declared 24).
sprint_stop: Five landings after the strike, not six: 55 frames over 3.95 m.
